messages:
ashley: FYI — LumaHealth flagged an unexpected Dedicated burst on Jun invoice INV-7810. They're asking for a review and possible SLA credit. Ticket SUP-13022.
diaz-fin: Can someone paste the invoice lines?
ashley: INV-7810 snippet:
```
INV-7810
- Reserved commit (Jun): $9,500
- Burst overage (06/29 03:05-03:40 UTC): $8,200
Total due: $17,700
```
omar: Platform note: there was an automated regional failover 06/29 03:04:52Z -> eu-west due to a transient network flap. Autoscaler launched nodes; allocator logs show 14 minutes of overlapping lifecycles for a subset of nodes. (ref INC-2026-490).
marta: If overlaps inflated hours, we should reconcile billed GPU-hours vs effective capacity. Any metering extract yet?
ops-bot: Metering job MR-5099 started. ETA 2h. Initial telemetry indicates ~46 duplicate GPU-hours correlated with allocator overlap.
diaz-fin: Quick calculation: at rate $56/hour -> 46 * 56 = $2,576 overbilled. Provisional rounding to $2,600.
ashley: Customer says they observed increased latency but no total outage and are asking for full refund of burst + an assurance it won't recur.
omar: Legal/CS caution: don't admit defect. Proposal: provisional credit CN-7810-PROV $2,600 while we complete reconciliation. Offer a 5% reserved-commit credit next invoice as goodwill.
marta: Approve provisional credit + 5% goodwill. We'll finalize after MR-5099 completes. Tag reason=failover-allocator-overlap.
billing-bot: Action: place collection hold on INV-7810; create provisional CN-7810-PROV amount $2,600. Note: hold prevents auto-collect.
diaz-fin: I'll prepare AR entry and hold. Also filing FIN-1175 to add allocator-overlap detection into billing pipeline.
ashley: I'll message the customer: "We're investigating and have applied a provisional credit of $2,600 pending final reconciliation; we'll follow up within 5 business days with final numbers and next steps."
ops-bot: Metering job MR-5099 finished. Reconciliation shows 44 duplicate GPU-hours. Final duplicate credit = 44 * $56 = $2,464.
diaz-fin: Finalize: post CN-7810-1 for $2,464 (reason=duplicate-provisioning). Reverse provisional CN-7810-PROV $2,600 -> net debit $-136 to AR. Process refund if payment captured.
billing-bot: Posting CN-7810-1 $2,464; reversing provisional CN-7810-PROV $2,600. Net adjustment -$136. Collection hold cleared. Refund queued if needed.
marta: I'll follow up with product on allocator race fix. Closing thread once refund confirmed. :white_check_mark:
